exec git init -b main
exec card init --prefix issue-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
cmp .cardamom/config.yaml $WORK/golden/random-config.yaml

exec card create 'random issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/random.txt

# Strategy selection is committed board configuration, not a CLI knob.
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: issue-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card create 'first sequential issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/first.txt
exec card create 'second sequential issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/second.txt

# Unknown strategies fail at the configuration boundary.
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: issue-\n    strategy: uuid\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
! exec card create 'invalid strategy'
! stdout .
stderr 'invalid issue ID strategy "uuid"'

-- golden/init.txt --
initialized .cardamom
This checkout now excludes Cardamom's local database and attachment blob files. .cardamom/config.yaml remains suitable to commit.
-- golden/random-config.yaml --
